outfit: the target outfit/costume identity: garment silhouette, materials, trim, and signature construction
lighting: the target lighting condition: color, direction, contrast, shadows, highlights, and atmosphere
pose: the target pose/composition: body arrangement, camera framing, limb geometry, and overall composition
painter_style: the target painterly style: brushwork, palette, line treatment, texture, and medium feel
anime_style: the target anime visual style: cel treatment, linework, palette, shading, texture, and graphic language
